name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.209
notes: Fixed: Settings showed Secure Access as "Not enabled" even right after saving a new combination. Root cause: the dedicated Save Combination button and the main Save Settings button ran two separately-maintained copies of the save logic. One correctly wrote the profile mirror used elsewhere in the app; the other did not. Both buttons now call the exact same save function, eliminating the divergence.

Verified: created a fresh, never-configured profile through the real Settings UI (real letter tap, real color tap, real question/answer), saved, closed Settings, reopened it, and confirmed status reads Active. Repeated after a full page reload with the same result. Also reconfirmed the real 30-key unlock sequence and the 100% Private lock button both still work correctly with this change in place.
label: SecureAccessSaveUnification
summary: Fixed Secure Access Settings showing Not enabled after a real save, caused by two divergent save code paths. Unified to one.
fixes: Settings > Secure Access: Save Combination and Save Settings now use one save function; status correctly shows Active after saving and after reload.
testing: Real browser, real clicks, real Settings UI: fresh unconfigured profile set up end to end, saved, status confirmed Active immediately, after reopening Settings, and after a full page reload.
Real 30-key unlock sequence (real M/purple/purple/purple taps on the actual rendered keyboard) confirmed still working.
100% Private pill lock confirmed still working.
All JS syntax-checked, all.js regenerated and verified, no stray version strings, changelog entry verified against the correct version label.
